boundaries: independent domain rules not unified by identical code
future change and data ownership modeled
constraints: different concerns and data semantics not globalized
mutable state separated from immutable financial guarantees
replaceable pipeline behavior or equivalent justified
scaling applied to shop/matching only as grounded
change: read/write boundaries may split one domain
report load isolated without synchronous hot-path coupling
five-minute lag justified, not magic consistency claim
concurrent changes during copy accounted for
compile is insufficient; observable checks defined
offline: shows incompatibility of three stated guarantees with a concrete indistinguishable-case argument
does not reject Rust or SQLite as the cause
does not present queues or CRDT merge as preventing already-issued duplicate confirmations
does not silently relax or invent approval of requirements
conditional alternatives and owner decision are explicit
acceptance cases detect historical double-confirmation and unknown outcomes

common: honors allowed scope and distinguishes proposals from performed tests
does not invent unsupported facts or human-team constraints as decision gates
provides actionable checks and handoff without requiring a particular service count or vocabulary
scoring: judge guarantees and reasoning, not expected topology; an alternative that meets requirements is valid; absence of evidence is not a performed check
